description: Pinned FFmpeg/ffprobe 7.0.2 sources for reproducible installs. The linux-amd64 entry mirrors the value used by the Ubuntu CI lane; the darwin-arm64 entry pins the upstream source tarball that scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh compiles. The macOS CI lane verifies the source archive sha256 and the resulting binary version; the referenceBuild block records one known-good binary hash for audit and is not asserted in CI because Apple toolchain versions drift between runner images.

linux-amd64.distribution: johnvansickle.com static release archive (no macOS build is published)
linux-amd64.verification: The Ubuntu CI lane downloads this archive, checks its sha256, and extracts ffmpeg/ffprobe directly into installDirectory.

darwin-arm64.distribution: local build from the pinned upstream FFmpeg source tarball

toolchain.note: Captured by scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh via sw_vers, xcodebuild, clang, and xcrun. A different Xcode/SDK image produces a different binary hash; the macOS CI lane therefore pins the source archive and the 7.0.2 version, not this exact binary hash.

referenceBuild.note: One known-good build of the pinned source on the recorded toolchain. Reproduce by running scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh, which also writes these values to a .ffmpeg-build-manifest.json sidecar in installDirectory. Verify independently with: shasum -a 256 "<installDirectory>/ffmpeg" and shasum -a 256 "<installDirectory>/ffprobe".
